title: Credential stitching, streaming throttle hints, and tri-SDK version bump (Go/Python/TS)
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: Mobile and edge customers reported sporadic higher tail latency when streams attempted to refresh credentials mid-request and when the SDK aggressively prefetched credentials. This PR unifies a light-weight credential stitching path across Go/TS/Python SDKs, introduces an opt-in streaming throttle hint header to smoother backpressure, and bumps SDK minor versions to pick up the ergonomics surface changes. Changes are intentionally conservative and backwards-compatible: old SessionBuilder APIs are shimmed to the new SessionFactory with deprecation warnings; the runtime path only uses credential stitching when REDWOOD_SDK_CRED_STITCH=enabled to avoid cross-product surprises. Implementation summary: 1) Credential stitcher: introduces a small coordinator that attempts local stitch of a short-lived lease token into an existing session without forcing a full reauth round-trip; this reduces windowed auth churn for high-throughput stream bursts. 2) Streaming throttle hints: SDKs now accept a numeric "x-redwood-throttle-hint" header from the server; the client will adjust prefetch and batching aggressiveness when present. 3) Ergonomic API polish: consolidated SessionFactory across languages, added WithThrottleHints and WithCredStitch options, and improved error messages for failed reauth attempts. 4) Safety: added runtime opt-out via env var and a toggle in client options for teams who prefer current behavior. Migration notes: rename SessionBuilder->SessionFactory in new examples (old symbol still exported with deprecation notice), to pick up the stitch behavior set REDWOOD_SDK_CRED_STITCH=enabled or call client.WithCredStitch(true). Testing: unit tests for stitch success/failure, integration tests to validate header propagation, e2e on a local canary service that simulates credential churn. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in ENG-1987 [x] unit + integration tests [x] multi-SDK version bumps and changelogs updated [x] docs samples updated [x] performance microbenchmark attached

review_comments: Asha: Can the stitcher fall back safely to a full reauth if stitching fails? (answered) - Priya: yes, stitcher returns ErrStitchFailed and the session layer performs a normal refresh as fallback.
Diego: Please add metrics for stitch attempts and stitch failures (requested) - Priya: added metrics stitch.attempts and stitch.failures and included in integration tests.

Claire: The deprecation notice for SessionBuilder should be visible in both runtime logs and docs (requested) - Priya: updated docs, examples, and logger to emit one-time deprecation warning at startup.

Mason: CI flaked on integration test twice, suggest retry wrapper (comment) - Priya: wrapped the canary test with a 3x retry and added jitter to token churn simulator to reduce deterministic timing races.
release_notes: SDK minor bumps: Go v1.5.0, Python 0.9.3, TypeScript 1.6.2
Introduce optional credential stitching to reduce auth churn during stream bursts (opt-in via env or client option)
Add server-driven streaming throttle hint header (x-redwood-throttle-hint) to allow client-side backpressure tuning
SessionBuilder deprecated in favor of SessionFactory; shim remains for backward compatibility
